intro.text:
* It is a butterscotch-
  cinnamon pie.

* I thought we might
  celebrate your
  arrival.

* I want you to have
  a nice time living
  here.

* So I will hold off
  on snail pie for
  tonight.

* Here, I have another
  surprise for you.

hard.text:
* Er, I assume that
  expression means you
  do.

* I have baked a snail
  pie.

* I thought we might
  celebrate your
  arrival.

* I want you to have
  a nice time living
  here.

* Here, I have another
  surprise for you.

books:
* These books are worn...
* They must have been read
  many times.
